canal_fly_boats.name: Canal Fly-Boats
canal_fly_boats.observation: Fly-boats change horses at every lock-house and run through the night, so a parcel crosses the shires in a day and a half.

public_plateway_hire.name: Toll Plateways
public_plateway_hire.observation: Any carter who pays the toll may run his wagons on the iron plate rails, and one horse draws what took four on the road.

scheduled_river_steamers.name: Scheduled River Steamers
scheduled_river_steamers.observation: A paddle steamer thrashes upstream against the flood on a printed schedule, trailing wood smoke over the towpath.
scheduled_river_steamers.ability_reason: Boats now keep a timetable upstream against the current, so goods and news move up the rivers on a set day instead of waiting on wind and towing teams.
scheduled_river_steamers.social_consequence: Towpath haulers and horse-boat owners lose their trade to the steamers.

passenger_canal_packets.name: Canal Passenger Packets
passenger_canal_packets.observation: Long narrow packet boats carry travellers at a steady trot, with a cabin for the gentry and the deck for everyone else.

steam_estuary_ferries.name: Steam Estuary Ferries
steam_estuary_ferries.observation: The ferry crosses the estuary on the hour whatever the tide, and the market towns on the two shores begin to trade as one.

steam_harbour_tugs.name: Steam Harbour Tugs
steam_harbour_tugs.observation: A squat steam tug takes a becalmed merchantman in tow and brings her through the harbour mouth against the wind.

town_omnibus_routes.name: Horse Omnibus Routes
town_omnibus_routes.observation: Long horse omnibuses ply fixed routes through the great towns, and clerks begin to live a few miles from their desks.

public_steam_railway.name: Public Steam Railway
public_steam_railway.observation: A steam locomotive draws a line of coal wagons and a carriage of passengers along iron rails faster than a galloping horse.
public_steam_railway.ability_reason: A locomotive hauls hundreds of tons at many times a horse's pace in any season, so coal, grain and goods move inland almost as cheaply as by water.
public_steam_railway.social_consequence: Carriers, coaching inns and turnpike trusts fail along the line, and landowners fight the surveyors at their gates.

multitube_locomotive_boilers.name: Many-Tubed Boilers
multitube_locomotive_boilers.observation: Flue tubes run through the boiler like reeds in a bundle, and the engine that carries them wins the trial by miles an hour.
multitube_locomotive_boilers.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Steam Locomotives from pressure vessels, bored cylinders, crank assemblies, 1435 mm rail wheelsets, wrought iron and steel, using wrought iron, timber and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

intercity_passenger_railway.name: Intercity Railway
intercity_passenger_railway.observation: A double-tracked line runs between two great cities, with booked seats, timed departures and a station hall at each end.
intercity_passenger_railway.ability_reason: Travellers and mail cross between the great cities in hours, so officials, merchants and troops can be where they are needed the same day.
intercity_passenger_railway.social_consequence: Stagecoach lines close within a few years, and the country towns the railway bypasses decline.

rail_track_foundations.observation: Rails fixed to timber sleepers and bedded in drained broken stone stay true under the heaviest trains.
rail_track_foundations.production_contract: Manufactures paid Timber Rail Panels and Track Ballast. Installed wagonways require a surveyed owned route, compatible wagons and brakes, actual construction work and continuing supplies. Capacity and crews remain committed through the return journey; worn or occupied routes cannot dispatch. The current haulage is human-worked; engines and animals are not supplied by this discovery.

classed_freight_tariffs.name: Freight Classes
classed_freight_tariffs.observation: The railway prints its tariff: coal at one rate, grain at another, fine goods dearer, so every shipper knows the charge before he sends.

merchant_chronometer_issue.name: Merchant Chronometers
merchant_chronometer_issue.observation: Even plain merchant ships now carry a chronometer, and any master can fix his longitude without a night of lunar tables.

ocean_steamship_line.name: Ocean Steamship Line
ocean_steamship_line.observation: A steamship leaves port on the advertised day and arrives across the ocean within a fortnight, her sails furled most of the way.
ocean_steamship_line.ability_reason: Ships cross the ocean on a fixed date whatever the wind, so trade, mail and emigrants cross on a schedule, and reinforcements for a distant general can be counted in days.
ocean_steamship_line.social_consequence: Sailing packet crews are undercut, and whole villages empty onto the emigrant steamers.

printed_railway_timetables.name: Railway Timetables
printed_railway_timetables.observation: A monthly railway guide lists every train in the realm, and people begin to set their watches by the station clock.

prepaid_stamp_postage.name: Prepaid Stamp Post
prepaid_stamp_postage.observation: A small gummed stamp pays for a letter to anywhere in the realm, and the mail sacks multiply beyond counting.
prepaid_stamp_postage.ability_reason: A letter costs the same to every corner of the realm and is paid in advance, so ordinary people and small traders write; orders, prices and news circulate as never before.
prepaid_stamp_postage.social_consequence: The post office becomes the largest civil employer in the realm, and families scattered by work stay in touch.

screw_propeller_ships.name: Screw Propellers
screw_propeller_ships.observation: A screw turning beneath the stern drives the ship where the paddle boxes once caught every wave.

steam_grain_elevators.name: Steam Grain Elevators
steam_grain_elevators.observation: Grain pours by chute from towering bins into railway cars, and a trainload is loaded in an hour without a single sack.

iron_hulled_steamers.name: Iron-Hulled Steamers
iron_hulled_steamers.observation: Iron hulls longer than any timber keel can bear carry holds that no wooden ship could ever hold together.

rail_express_parcels.name: Railway Express Parcels
rail_express_parcels.observation: Express carriers put parcels on the fast trains and deliver them door to door the next morning.

rail_gauge_standards.observation: The realm fixes one gauge for every railway, and the odd-gauge lines are relaid at their owners' cost.
rail_gauge_standards.ability_reason: Every wagon runs on every line, so goods and troops cross the realm without unloading at the gauge breaks.
rail_gauge_standards.production_contract: Manufactures paid Rail Gauge Templates, 900 mm and 1435 mm Rail Wheelsets and the matching Rail Wagons. Installed wagonways require a surveyed owned route, compatible wagons and brakes, actual construction work and continuing supplies. Capacity and crews remain committed through the return journey; worn or occupied routes cannot dispatch. The current haulage is human-worked; engines and animals are not supplied by this discovery.

railway_clearing_house.name: Railway Clearing House
railway_clearing_house.observation: Clerks at the clearing house divide each through-fare among the companies whose rails the traveller used.

travelling_post_office_cars.name: Travelling Post Offices
travelling_post_office_cars.observation: Clerks sort letters in a moving mail car, and bags are snatched from trackside posts without the train slowing.

fast_clipper_hulls.name: Clipper Hulls
fast_clipper_hulls.observation: Sharp-bowed clippers crowd on sail and race home with the first cargo of the season for the richest prices.

wind_current_passage_charts.name: Wind and Current Charts
wind_current_passage_charts.observation: Charts compiled from thousands of logbooks show where the winds and currents run, and ocean passages shorten by weeks.

telegraph_train_dispatch.name: Telegraph Train Orders
telegraph_train_dispatch.observation: A dispatcher telegraphs an order to hold one train in a siding while the other passes on the single line.

interlocked_rail_signals.name: Interlocked Signals
interlocked_rail_signals.observation: In the signal box the levers lock one another, so no signalman can set two trains onto the same stretch of line.

sleeping_dining_cars.name: Sleeping and Dining Cars
sleeping_dining_cars.observation: Passengers sleep in berths and dine at linen-covered tables while the long-distance train runs on through the night.

ocean_coaling_stations.name: Coaling Stations
ocean_coaling_stations.observation: Coal heaps and lighters wait at island harbours along the ocean routes, so steamers need not carry fuel for the whole voyage.
ocean_coaling_stations.social_consequence: Island harbours become garrisoned coal depots, and their people become coal heavers.

sea_collision_rules.name: Rules of the Road at Sea
sea_collision_rules.observation: Every ship shows a red light to port and a green to starboard, and gives way to another by the same rule.

underground_town_railway.name: Underground Railway
underground_town_railway.observation: Trains run in covered cuttings beneath the streets of the great town, their tunnels thick with engine smoke.

compound_marine_engines.name: Compound Marine Engines
compound_marine_engines.observation: Steam passes through a second, larger cylinder before it is spent, and a steamer crosses the ocean on half the coal.

crude_oil_pipelines.name: Crude Oil Pipelines
crude_oil_pipelines.observation: Iron pipes carry crude oil from the wells to the railhead, and the barrel teamsters are out of work.

rolled_steel_rails.name: Steel Rails
rolled_steel_rails.observation: Rails rolled from steel outlast iron rails many times over under the heaviest traffic.

continental_trunk_railway.name: Continental Railway
continental_trunk_railway.observation: The last rail is laid where two lines built from opposite coasts meet among the mountains.
continental_trunk_railway.ability_reason: A railway across the continent joins the two coasts, so settlers, troops and freight reach the far interior in a week instead of a season.
continental_trunk_railway.social_consequence: The lands along the line are fenced and settled, and the herders and hunters who lived there are pushed off them.

isthmus_ship_canal.name: Isthmus Ship Canal
isthmus_ship_canal.observation: A sea-level canal cut through a narrow isthmus lets ships pass between two seas without rounding a continent.
isthmus_ship_canal.ability_reason: Ships cut a continent's length from their voyages, and whoever holds the canal controls one of the great sea roads of the world.
isthmus_ship_canal.social_consequence: Thousands of labourers die of fever digging the cut.

rail_vehicle_braking.observation: Air brakes worked from the locomotive stop the whole train together, and long heavy trains become safe to run.

mail_order_parcel_trade.name: Mail-Order Catalogues
mail_order_parcel_trade.observation: Farm families order ploughs, cloth and stoves from a thick catalogue and collect them at the railway station.
mail_order_parcel_trade.social_consequence: Village shopkeepers lose their customers to the catalogue houses.

automatic_rail_couplers.name: Automatic Couplers
automatic_rail_couplers.observation: Wagons couple themselves when pushed together, and brakemen no longer lose their fingers between the buffers.

interrealm_postal_union.name: Postal Union of Realms
interrealm_postal_union.observation: Envoys of many realms agree that a letter crossing a border pays one rate and is carried by each post in turn.
interrealm_postal_union.ability_reason: Letters and parcels cross every border at one rate, so a merchant or envoy can deal with any realm by post.

hull_load_lines.name: Load Lines
hull_load_lines.observation: A mark painted on every hull shows how deep she may lie, and overloaded ships are held in port.
hull_load_lines.social_consequence: Owners who sent rotten, overloaded ships to sea for the insurance are brought to account.

refrigerated_rail_cars.name: Refrigerated Rail Cars
refrigerated_rail_cars.observation: Ice bunkers at each end of the car keep meat fresh from the stockyards to the coast.

triple_expansion_freighters.name: Triple-Expansion Freighters
triple_expansion_freighters.observation: Three cylinders use the steam in turn, and a plain freighter carries grain across the ocean for a few coppers a sack.

railway_standard_time.name: Railway Standard Time
railway_standard_time.observation: Railway clocks across the realm are set to one standard hour, and the old town noon is forgotten.
railway_standard_time.ability_reason: Every station in a zone keeps the same hour, so schedules, telegraphs and mobilization tables can be set to the minute across the realm.

chain_drive_bicycle.name: Safety Bicycle
chain_drive_bicycle.observation: A chain-driven bicycle with two equal wheels lets a clerk or a farm girl ride ten miles to work.
chain_drive_bicycle.social_consequence: Young women ride out without chaperones, to the alarm of their elders.

motor_carriage.name: Motor Carriage
motor_carriage.observation: A petrol engine drives a carriage along the road without horses, frightening every animal it passes.
motor_carriage.ability_reason: A self-propelled carriage runs on any road without a horse; it is still costly and fragile, but it points to transport free of the rail and the stable.

electric_street_tramways.name: Electric Tramways
electric_street_tramways.observation: Tramcars run on current from overhead wires, and the town streets are no longer ankle-deep in horse dung.

pneumatic_tyres.name: Pneumatic Tyres
pneumatic_tyres.observation: Air-filled rubber tyres take the jolts of the road, and wheels roll faster over rough setts.

tramp_bulk_charters.name: Tramp Steamers
tramp_bulk_charters.observation: Tramp steamers go wherever a cargo waits, carrying coal outward and grain home.

steam_turbine_ships.name: Turbine Ships
steam_turbine_ships.observation: A turbine spins the shafts directly with steam, and the fast liners cut days from the ocean crossing.

hump_marshalling_yards.name: Hump Yards
hump_marshalling_yards.observation: Wagons pushed over a low hump roll by gravity into their sidings, and a whole train is sorted in an hour.

hull_condition_surveys.observation: Independent surveyors examine each hull at set intervals, and underwriters insure only ships that keep their class.

tar_bound_road_surfaces.name: Tarred Roads
tar_bound_road_surfaces.observation: Tar sprayed over the broken stone lays the dust that motor traffic raised in choking clouds.

driver_licensing.name: Driving Licences
driver_licensing.observation: Every motorist carries a licence and every car a registered number plate, so a reckless driver can be traced.

motor_freight_lorries.name: Motor Lorries
motor_freight_lorries.observation: Motor lorries carry freight from the railhead to farms and shops that no train reaches.

motor_bus_routes.name: Motor Buses
motor_bus_routes.observation: Motor buses replace the horse omnibus and run on to villages that never had a service.

series_built_motor_car.name: Series-Built Motor Car
series_built_motor_car.observation: Motor cars come off a moving line in long series, cheap enough for a farmer or a clerk to buy.
series_built_motor_car.ability_reason: Ordinary households can own a car, so people and goods move door to door without rails, and towns spread out along the roads.
series_built_motor_car.social_consequence: Road deaths climb every year, and the streets are given over to machines.
series_built_motor_car.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Motor Car Chassis from combustion engines, steel, steel sheets, gear sets, shaft bearings and insulated cable, using basic machine tool sets and steel. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

motor_road_fund.name: Road Fund
motor_road_fund.observation: A road board builds and mends motor roads from what motorists pay in fuel and licence taxes.

passenger_airships.name: Passenger Airships
passenger_airships.observation: A great gas-filled airship carries passengers across the sea on a schedule, until one burns at her mooring mast.

radio_direction_finding.name: Radio Direction-Finding
radio_direction_finding.observation: A ship takes bearings on two shore wireless stations and fixes her position through fog.

heavy_oil_motor_ships.name: Motor Ships
heavy_oil_motor_ships.observation: Heavy-oil engines drive the new motor ships, which carry fuel for a voyage round the world and need no stokers.

wireless_distress_watch.name: Wireless Distress Watch
wireless_distress_watch.observation: Every passenger ship must keep a wireless operator listening day and night for a distress call.

state_parcel_post.name: Parcel Post
state_parcel_post.observation: The state post carries parcels as well as letters, at one rate to every village in the realm.

lock_ship_canal_divide.name: High-Lock Ship Canal
lock_ship_canal_divide.observation: A flight of great locks lifts ocean ships over a mountain divide and lowers them into the other sea.
lock_ship_canal_divide.ability_reason: Ocean ships are lifted over the divide and cross between oceans in a day, so fleets and cargoes can shift between seas at will.
lock_ship_canal_divide.social_consequence: Fever camps and a foreign-held zone along the canal breed resentment for a generation.

electric_traffic_signals.name: Traffic Signals
electric_traffic_signals.observation: Red, amber and green lamps at the crossings replace the constable's white gloves.

roadside_fuel_stations.name: Filling Stations
roadside_fuel_stations.observation: Pumps at the roadside fill a motor car's tank in minutes, and long journeys by road become ordinary.

scheduled_air_mail.name: Scheduled Air Mail
scheduled_air_mail.observation: Mail planes fly the length of the realm by day and by beacon-lit night, and a letter arrives the next morning.
scheduled_air_mail.ability_reason: Letters cross the realm overnight by air, so a sealed order or a contract reaches a distant city in a day.

passenger_air_service.name: Passenger Airlines
passenger_air_service.observation: Airliners carry paying passengers between the capitals in hours, landing on grass fields outside the town.

state_railway_administration.name: State Railways
state_railway_administration.observation: The state buys out the railway companies and runs every line from one administration.
state_railway_administration.social_consequence: Railwaymen become servants of the state, and every rise in fares becomes a political quarrel.

limited_access_motorways.name: Motorways
limited_access_motorways.observation: Divided motor roads with no level crossings or side turnings let traffic run at speed between the cities.
limited_access_motorways.ability_reason: Motor traffic runs at speed with no crossings or junction delays, so lorries and troops move between regions in hours.
limited_access_motorways.social_consequence: Farms and villages are cut in two by embankments with no crossing.

tractor_trailer_rigs.name: Articulated Lorries
tractor_trailer_rigs.observation: A tractor unit hauls a detachable trailer, and a single driver moves as much as a railway wagon.

centralized_traffic_control.name: Centralized Traffic Control
centralized_traffic_control.observation: One dispatcher sets every signal and switch across a district from a lit panel in the control room.

airway_radio_beacons.name: Airway Beacons
airway_radio_beacons.observation: Radio beacons mark the night air routes, and a pilot follows the steady tone between them.

airport_control_towers.name: Control Towers
airport_control_towers.observation: From a glass tower above the field, a controller clears each airplane to land or take off by radio.

electrified_main_lines.name: Electrified Main Lines
electrified_main_lines.observation: Electric locomotives draw current from overhead wires and haul the heavy trains without smoke.

pallet_forklift_handling.name: Pallets and Fork-Lifts
pallet_forklift_handling.observation: A small truck with steel forks lifts a whole pallet of cases, and one driver does the work of a gang of porters.
pallet_forklift_handling.ability_reason: Loads are lifted on standard pallets instead of carried sack by sack, so warehouses, depots and army supply dumps turn over their stock in a fraction of the time.
pallet_forklift_handling.social_consequence: Dock and warehouse gangs shrink as the fork-lifts take their work.

road_haulage_licensing.name: Haulage Licences
road_haulage_licensing.observation: Every road haulier must hold a licence, and the number of lorries on each route is fixed by the board.

oil_electric_locomotives.name: Oil-Electric Locomotives
oil_electric_locomotives.observation: Oil-engined locomotives with electric drive pull the expresses, and the engine sheds fall silent.
oil_electric_locomotives.ability_reason: Oil-electric engines run for days without coaling or watering stops, with a fraction of the crews that steam needed.
oil_electric_locomotives.social_consequence: Firemen and shed crews lose their trade, and the coal towns lose the railway's custom.

metal_monoplane_airliners.name: Metal Airliners
metal_monoplane_airliners.observation: All-metal monoplanes carry twenty passengers at a profit, and air travel stops needing a subsidy.

pressurized_airliner_cabins.name: Pressurized Cabins
pressurized_airliner_cabins.observation: The cabin is pressurized, and the airliner flies high above the storms where the air is smooth.

hyperbolic_radio_navigation.name: Radio Navigation Grids
hyperbolic_radio_navigation.observation: A navigator reads the time difference between pulses from paired stations and finds his place on a lattice chart.

civil_aviation_convention.name: Civil Aviation Convention
civil_aviation_convention.observation: The realms agree who may fly over whose land and land where, and on one set of rules for the air.

radar_approach_control.name: Radar Approach Control
radar_approach_control.observation: A controller watching the radar screen talks each airliner down to the runway through cloud.

sustained_airlift.name: Sustained Airlift
sustained_airlift.observation: Transport aircraft land every few minutes, day and night, and a blockaded city lives on what they bring.

jet_airliners.name: Jet Airliners
jet_airliners.observation: Jet airliners cross the ocean in an afternoon, high above the weather.
jet_airliners.ability_reason: Travellers cross oceans in hours, so envoys, experts and traders can meet in person anywhere in the world within a day.
jet_airliners.social_consequence: Distant epidemics arrive by air within days, and the ocean liners are laid up.

roll_on_roll_off_ferries.name: Roll-On Ferries
roll_on_roll_off_ferries.observation: Lorries and cars drive aboard through the bow doors and drive off on the far shore.

intermodal_shipping_containers.name: Shipping Containers
intermodal_shipping_containers.observation: A steel box packed at an inland factory is lifted aboard ship and delivered unopened to a store across the ocean.
intermodal_shipping_containers.ability_reason: Cargo moves from ship to lorry to train sealed in one steel box, and shipping becomes so cheap that goods are made wherever labour costs least.
intermodal_shipping_containers.social_consequence: Dockside neighbourhoods and their gangs of stevedores vanish within a generation.

national_highway_network.name: National Motorway Network
national_highway_network.observation: A motorway grid paid from the fuel tax links every region of the realm.
national_highway_network.ability_reason: A motorway grid links every region, so goods, people and troops move by road anywhere in the realm in a day.
national_highway_network.social_consequence: Branch railways close and town centres empty as trade moves to the highway edges.

orbital_satellite_launch.name: First Satellite
orbital_satellite_launch.observation: A many-stage rocket lifts a small metal sphere into orbit, and its bleeping signal is heard around the world.
orbital_satellite_launch.ability_reason: Rockets can now place a machine in orbit, where it can relay signals and look down on the whole planet; the realm that does it first is noticed everywhere.

very_large_tankers.name: Supertankers
very_large_tankers.observation: Tankers longer than a town street carry a million barrels of oil around the capes.
very_large_tankers.social_consequence: A single wreck spills enough oil to foul a hundred miles of coast.

container_gantry_terminals.name: Container Terminals
container_gantry_terminals.observation: Gantry cranes lift boxes straight from ship to lorry, and a ship is turned round in a day instead of a week.

bulk_unit_trains.name: Unit Trains
bulk_unit_trains.observation: One long train carries nothing but coal from the mine to the port, loading and unloading without stopping.

dedicated_bulk_carriers.name: Bulk Carriers
dedicated_bulk_carriers.observation: Ships built for one cargo, ore or grain, load by conveyor and unload by grab.

computer_seat_reservations.name: Computer Reservations
computer_seat_reservations.observation: Booking clerks across the realm query one electronic machine and sell every seat on every flight without double booking.

crewed_orbital_flight.name: Crewed Orbital Flight
crewed_orbital_flight.observation: A pilot circles the earth in a small capsule and comes home under a parachute.

high_speed_rail_lines.name: High-Speed Rail
high_speed_rail_lines.observation: Streamlined electric trains run on their own dedicated tracks at speeds that approach an airliner's.
high_speed_rail_lines.ability_reason: Passenger trains at nearly airliner speeds link the cities of a region, so the capital and the provinces share one working day.

satellite_ship_navigation.name: Satellite Ship Navigation
satellite_ship_navigation.observation: Ships fix their position from the signals of passing satellites, in any weather, anywhere on the ocean.

standard_container_sizes.name: Standard Container Sizes
standard_container_sizes.observation: The realms agree on the length, height and corner fittings of containers, so any crane can lift any box.

crewed_lunar_landing.name: Moon Landing
crewed_lunar_landing.observation: Two crewmen step onto the moon's grey dust, plant a flag and come home with a box of stones.
crewed_lunar_landing.ability_reason: A crew lands on the moon and returns, a proof of reach and organization that raises the realm's standing everywhere, though it carries nothing that matters on earth.

wide_body_hub_flights.name: Wide-Body Airliners
wide_body_hub_flights.observation: Wide-bodied airliners carry hundreds at once to great hub airports, and flying becomes cheap enough for holidays.

automated_high_bay_warehouses.name: High-Bay Warehouses
automated_high_bay_warehouses.observation: Stacker cranes run between racks forty pallets high, storing and fetching goods by punched instruction.

overnight_air_express.name: Overnight Air Express
overnight_air_express.observation: Parcels from every city fly to one hub at midnight, are sorted, and fly out again before dawn.
overnight_air_express.ability_reason: Any parcel or spare part reaches any city by the next morning, so factories and field depots can hold less stock.

scanned_product_barcodes.name: Bar Codes
scanned_product_barcodes.observation: Every tin and packet carries a printed bar code, and the till reads the price and counts the stock.
scanned_product_barcodes.ability_reason: Every item scanned at the till and on the dock is counted, so stocks are known exactly and reordered before the shelves run bare.

just_in_time_supply.name: Just-in-Time Supply
just_in_time_supply.observation: Parts arrive at the assembly line the hour they are needed, and the factory keeps almost no store.
just_in_time_supply.social_consequence: One late lorry can stop a whole assembly line.

transport_deregulation.name: Transport Deregulation
transport_deregulation.observation: The licensing boards are abolished, and any carrier may run any route at any price.
transport_deregulation.social_consequence: Old carriers go bankrupt, and small towns lose their services to cheaper routes elsewhere.

double_stack_container_trains.name: Double-Stack Trains
double_stack_container_trains.observation: Containers ride two high on long well-wagons, doubling what each train carries.

electronic_shipping_documents.name: Electronic Shipping Papers
electronic_shipping_documents.observation: Bills of lading and customs papers pass between firms as electronic messages, and cargo no longer waits for the post.

supply_chain_management.name: Supply Chain Management
supply_chain_management.observation: Suppliers, carriers and sellers plan one flow of goods together, sharing forecasts and stock counts.

low_cost_point_airlines.name: Low-Cost Airlines
low_cost_point_airlines.observation: Cheap airlines fly directly between secondary cities, and a weekend abroad costs less than a train fare.

open_satellite_positioning.name: Open Satellite Positioning
open_satellite_positioning.observation: A pocket receiver listening to a constellation of satellites tells anyone their place on earth to within a few paces.
open_satellite_positioning.ability_reason: Anyone can fix position to within a few metres anywhere, so every driver, ship and survey party knows exactly where it is.

online_order_parcel_tracking.name: Online Orders and Tracking
online_order_parcel_tracking.observation: A household orders from a seller in another city at midnight and watches its parcel cross the realm on a screen.
online_order_parcel_tracking.ability_reason: Households order from any seller and follow the parcel to their door, so shops that cannot deliver lose their customers.
online_order_parcel_tracking.social_consequence: High streets empty, and warehouse and delivery work multiplies at piece rates.

shared_orbital_station.name: Shared Orbital Station
shared_orbital_station.observation: Crews from several realms live aboard a station in orbit all year round, relieved by visiting ships.

automatic_ship_identification.name: Ship Identification Transponders
automatic_ship_identification.observation: Every large ship broadcasts her name, course and speed, and the coast stations see the whole traffic on one screen.

urban_congestion_charging.name: Congestion Charges
urban_congestion_charging.observation: Drivers pay a daily charge to enter the town centre, and traffic thins within a week.
urban_congestion_charging.social_consequence: Tradesmen and suburban commuters protest a tax on getting to work.

rfid_pallet_tags.name: Radio Pallet Tags
rfid_pallet_tags.observation: Radio tags on every pallet are read as they pass through the warehouse door, without anyone scanning them.

in_car_satellite_routing.name: Satellite Car Routing
in_car_satellite_routing.observation: A small screen on the dashboard speaks each turn, and drivers stop carrying road atlases.

ultra_large_container_ships.name: Ultra-Large Container Ships
ultra_large_container_ships.observation: Container ships carrying twenty thousand boxes call at only a handful of giant ports.
ultra_large_container_ships.social_consequence: When one of these ships runs aground in a narrow channel, trade across half the world waits.

live_traffic_mapping.name: Live Traffic Maps
live_traffic_mapping.observation: Pocket telephones report their own speed, and the map shows every jam as it forms.

app_ride_hailing.name: Ride-Hailing
app_ride_hailing.observation: A pocket telephone summons a nearby driver in a private car, and the fare is settled without cash.
app_ride_hailing.social_consequence: Licensed cab drivers lose their trade to part-time drivers without guaranteed wages.

warehouse_robot_fleets.name: Warehouse Robots
warehouse_robot_fleets.observation: Squat robots carry whole shelving racks to the pickers, and the warehouse aisles fill with machines.

mass_battery_electric_cars.name: Battery-Electric Cars
mass_battery_electric_cars.observation: Battery cars roll silently through the town, charging overnight from a plug in the wall.
mass_battery_electric_cars.ability_reason: Cars run on stored electricity, so road transport no longer depends on imported oil and the town air clears; the cost moves to the mines for battery metals.
mass_battery_electric_cars.social_consequence: The districts that mine battery metals bear the scars of the boom.

reusable_orbital_boosters.name: Reusable Boosters
reusable_orbital_boosters.observation: The rocket's first stage flies back and lands upright on its own tail, ready to fly again.

battery_electric_buses.name: Electric Buses
battery_electric_buses.observation: Battery buses charge at the depot overnight and run all day in near silence.

supply_chain_resilience_reviews.name: Supply Resilience Reviews
supply_chain_resilience_reviews.observation: After shortages close the factories, firms and ministries map every supplier and lay in stocks of critical goods.

drone_parcel_delivery.name: Drone Parcel Delivery
drone_parcel_delivery.observation: Small drones drop parcels into gardens across licensed suburbs, to the complaints of the neighbours.

low_carbon_ship_fuels.name: Low-Carbon Ship Fuels
low_carbon_ship_fuels.observation: The first cargo ships burn methanol or ammonia, at a higher fuel bill, and their funnels emit little carbon.

driverless_highway_freight.name: Driverless Freight
driverless_highway_freight.observation: Lorries with no one at the wheel run the motorway corridors day and night.
driverless_highway_freight.ability_reason: Lorries run the motorway corridors around the clock without drivers, so freight never waits on a rest break.
driverless_highway_freight.social_consequence: Lorry driving, the largest trade in many districts, faces ruin.

electric_air_taxis.name: Electric Air Taxis
electric_air_taxis.observation: Small electric craft lift four passengers from a rooftop pad and hop across the town.
